name: graphify-plugin
description: Let reverse-engineering start from external structural maps instead of a cold scan, in single- and multi-repo workspaces, where each map is built by Graphify (https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify), which writes one under <repo>/graphify-out/. This plugin tells the Developer code scan to use it as an INDEX for deciding which files to open, and — because Graphify tags every edge EXTRACTED or INFERRED — lets the duty to confirm every borrowed claim in the source file be spent where it is actually needed. Overlay-only: two fragments in reverse-engineering (Inception), the converter tool (tools/graphify-map.ts) that turns each repo's map into per-repo knowledge files (the repo name is in every file name and heading), and the shared rules file (knowledge/aidlc-shared/external-code-map.md) that every inline and delegated agent loads. The map is evidence, never truth, and it never replaces reverse-engineering — that stage still owns the CodeKB store, whose freshness fingerprint only the tool can mint. Conditional throughout: with no map present nothing here asks for one and its absence is not a gap. A tree takes exactly one code-map plugin: ua-plugin is the alternative.
